entities.summary: Zachary Stephen Lee is an American former professional baseball pitcher. The Los Angeles Dodgers drafted him in the first round of the 2010 MLB draft and signed him for $5.25 million. He made his Major League Baseball (MLB) debut for the Dodgers in 2015 and also played for the San Diego Padres in 2017.
